text:
maya: heads-up: build 9014 blocked - artifact-verify failing during staging promote at 08:10 PT. https://ci.example.com/builds/9014
li: logs show manifest mismatch + intermittent cache write failures. snippet:
```
artifact-verify: expected sha256:beefcafe, found sha256:badc0ffe
worker write tmp shard -> EIO
```
deploy-bot: promotion paused after 4 auto-retries.
ci-bot: promotion status: PAUSED (failure reason: artifact_verify_error).
product-lead: customer demo at 08:45 PT. we need decision for 08:30 change window.
sre-oncall: storage team reporting transient disk error on one node, causing corrupt temp writes. best short-term: quarantine this build and promote previous stable image to canary.
li: alternatives: 1) wait 20m and retry (risk missing demo), 2) promote last-known-good sha256:1234abcd, 3) force-rebuild (takes ~50m).
maya: consensus seems option 2 to meet SLA. @deploy-bot promote sha256:1234abcd to canary, quarantine 9014 and open bug.
deploy-bot: running: `deploybot promote --env canary --image sha256:1234abcd --reason "artifact-verify mismatch build 9014"`
deploy-bot: promote complete. canary routing updated. promotion_log: /deploy/logs/7970000000/promote-1234abcd
ci-bot: scheduled artifact reverify for 9014 once storage marks node healthy. will rerun pipeline automatically.
product-lead: thanks, please notify customer contacts about pinned image and follow-up timeline.
maya: marking change-window met. will monitor and escalate if storage reports recurring corruption. :thumbsup:
